Paste the message you got, pick a vibe, and run the generator. It writes 3 reply options in that vibe and shows them under the box. Copy the one you like.

1. Open [Text Reply Generator](https://text-reply.lazur.app/).
2. Paste the message you got into the box. Paste the exact text, not a summary of it.
3. Pick a vibe: Friendly, Funny, Flirty, Polite no, Firm or Apology.
4. Run the generator and wait 1 to 3 seconds.
5. Copy one reply with one click, then change a word if it does not sound like you.

**Read the reply out loud before you send it.** If you would not say it to that person, pick another option or run it again with a different vibe.

sections.heading: Pick the vibe that fits the message
sections.body:
The vibe tells the generator what tone to use. Friendly is warm and simple. Funny is light and playful. Flirty adds a little warmth and teasing. Polite no says no kindly and clearly. Firm sets a clear limit. Apology says sorry and offers to make things right.

The vibe changes the tone, not the facts. If the message asks you for something you cannot do, every reply still has to say so. Check each option before you copy it.

sections.heading: What you get back
sections.body:
You get 3 separate reply options. Each one is short and written the way people text, not like an essay. They are shown one after another, so you can compare them and choose.

The generator does not send anything for you. You copy a reply, go back to your app, paste it and send it yourself.

sections.heading: When the replies miss
sections.body:
If none of the three options feels right, the message often lacks context. The generator writes from the text you paste, so a bare word like lol gives it little to work with. Paste the exact message, and the line before it if that helps, then try another vibe.

Each run counts toward your daily free runs, so pick the vibe you want before you run it, and compare the options before you run it again.

sections.heading: Keep it light and specific
sections.body:
A flirty reply usually refers to one detail from their message, then keeps going with a question or a small tease. Short beats long. A line or two is enough.

Avoid stacking three compliments into one reply, and avoid anything you would not say in person. The generator only sees the text you paste. It does not know how well you know the person, so you decide what fits.

Match the energy of the message. If they wrote a long, careful text, a long, careful reply often feels right. If they sent one emoji and a question mark, keep your reply just as short. A flirty reply that is too big for the moment can feel like pressure, even when every word is friendly.
